method.order: BA, AB, BA, AB, BA after AB warmup; A=77f1383b, B=optimized
method.inputs: DeepSeek model3 and the same frozen native project archive
method.boundary: load_begin to GPU end of the first actually presented model preview; separately to drawable presentedTime
method.scope: Fresh native window, empty workspace/selection, cold per-process texture cache; excludes application initialization/file picker. Filesystem/driver caches not cleared.
method.retry: A dropped model drawable requests a retained-image window redraw. Preview identity must remain the same. GPU end time is the original model render; presentedTime includes redraw waiting.
method.environment_limit: Normal desktop activity; CPU/I/O/display focus not isolated. Mac desktop unlocked; main reported display 120 Hz mirrored to another reported 60 Hz display.
method.trace: Accepted preview label -> composition surface -> successful Metal GPU commands -> first actual drawable presentation; all full traces have zero lost events.
